title: Lawyer's office and car robbed

tellings.quote: No, but my lawyer had her office and her car robbed.

plain: Gary McKinnon, a British man who hacked into NASA computers and says he found signs of a secret space programme, says that during his legal fight in the 2000s his lawyer had both her office and her car robbed. He tells it from his own experience. He raises it as a hint that someone was taking an interest in his case.
